prayerExcerpt.en-US: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him who brings glad tidings of peace.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Como são belos sobre os montes os pés do mensageiro que anuncia a paz.

meta.face: A spare, weathered Frank of about sixty, clean-shaven, with a BROAD, SQUARE-BROWED face narrowing only a little to a wide, strongly CLEFT chin — a straight, flat brow line, small, deep-set, very pale grey-blue eyes crinkled against the northern wind, a short, straight nose with a broad bridge, lean cheeks with long vertical creases, a wide, straight, thin-lipped mouth; short, straight flaxen hair gone silver, cut in a straight Carolingian fringe around the shaven monastic crown; wind-reddened cheeks; a calm, far-seeing gaze a little to one side.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; Rimbert's Life tells of a Frankish monk of Corbie who wore a hair shirt and lived on bread and water, and the tradition (as in Bendixen's painting) shows him clean-shaven with a church in his hand. The square, cleft-chinned face and flaxen fringe are our choice.
